author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17 and checked against the artifact rather than the source. The per-field comments still describe the fields they annotate, and the schema boundary they exist to protect is intact BOTH ways: the dataclass fields and the keys persisted in .coord/index/coordinates.json are the same set exactly - nothing on the dataclass goes unpersisted, nothing persisted is missing from the dataclass. The 'volatile, informational' note on the location fields still matches lineage's use of body/shape hashes rather than position.
